name: singlet_qc_mito_fraction_cutoff_by_tissue
title: Mitochondrial fraction cutoff by tissue
description: Flags cells whose mitochondrial UMI percent is high relative to their own group (tissue, sample or cluster) and reports the cutoff fitted for each group. The default mad method is a published heuristic; miqc and mitochontrol return compromise posteriors and need a seed. Do not use it on single-nucleus libraries, where mitochondrial counts are near zero; use the nucleus-aware filter instead. It writes obs/pct_mito, obs/mito_flag and uns/mito_cutoff_by_group and does not remove cells.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

species.description: Sets the mitochondrial gene prefix: MT- for human, mt- for mouse; other reads var/mito. No safe default.

method.description: mad: upper-tail MAD on logit fraction with floor (default). fixed: constant bound. miqc, mitochontrol: model posteriors.

group_by.description: obs column defining fit groups, such as tissue or sample; use the cluster key for mitochontrol. Null means the whole dataset.

nmads.description: Upper-tail threshold in unscaled MADs above the group median of the transformed fraction.

transform.description: Scale on which the median and MAD are computed: logit (with pseudocount) or identity.

floor_percent.description: Percent of UMIs a cell must also exceed to be flagged (AND rule); null disables the floor.

mito_percent.description: Cells with mitochondrial percent above this are flagged; a tutorial convention, comparator only.

posterior_cutoff.description: Cells with posterior probability of the compromised component above this are flagged.

model_type.description: Regression of mitochondrial percent on detected genes: linear, spline, polynomial or one-dimensional.

enforce_left_cutoff.description: Also flag low-complexity cells with mitochondrial percent at or above the least-mitochondrial flagged cell.

threshold_prob.description: Posterior probability threshold for the compromised component within each group.

seed.description: Initialisation seed for miqc and mitochontrol mixtures; mad and fixed are deterministic.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, for example obs/mito_flag. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Completed runs: method, groups, cells_in, cells_flagged and cutoff_range (percent). Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
